summary: @ornikar/rollup-plugin-postcss ships preinstall dropper that runs an obfuscated payload under a downloaded Bun runtime
details: This package impersonates the upstream egoist/rollup-plugin-postcss under the @ornikar/ scope: package.json reuses upstream author/repo/README/CHANGELOG and dist/index.js verbatim, but adds a preinstall hook ("scripts.preinstall": "node setup.mjs") plus setup.mjs and math_init.js — files that do not exist upstream. On npm install, setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it, chmods the bun binary executable, and invokes it against the sibling math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line obfuscated blob (rotated string/opcode array, hex-mangled identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` banner) whose filename does not correspond to any Rollup PostCSS plugin functionality. Executing bundled code under a freshly-fetched alternate runtime at preinstall bypasses Node-based supply-chain scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code, and the opaque obfuscated payload runs with the installer's user privileges on npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
